lines_of_business: Medicare Only (Providence Health Plan, Health Assurance, Plan Partners)
sections_in_order: Policy Guidelines (Background, Coverage Quick Guide, Replacement, ULTepap)
criteria_location: Medicare Coverage Criteria table (p.2-3) points to NCD 240.4 and LCDs L33718 / L33800; clinical criteria themselves are not reproduced. Only replacement rules (p.5-6) and EPAP exclusion are stated in full.

logic.top_level: pathways (a device x condition lookup matrix pointing at external CMS documents)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: E0471 not covered for primary OSA; EPAP A7049 not DME so denied; CPAP for non-OSA denied.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Replacement: 5-year reasonable useful lifetime; earlier replacement only lost/stolen/irreparably damaged or change in condition.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Replacement ... prior to the 5-year RUL is eligible for coverage only in select situations (e.g., lost, stolen, irreparably damaged)

requirement_kinds.quote: Both NCD and LCD criteria include diagnosis of OSA for coverage
HCPCS code E0471 is not medically necessary for a primary diagnosis of OSA
documentation of the specific incident of irreparable damage or a written explanation regarding the loss
The member must be regularly using the equipment as prescribed; and, the equipment continues to provide the needed therapeutic benefit

thresholds.quote: The reasonable useful lifetime (RUL) for PAP and RAD equipment is 5 years.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Quick Guide matrix maps HCPCS code x condition to NCD/LCD.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: A7049 EPAP denied; E0471 for OSA

external_dependencies.quote: If there is a conflict between the Company Medicare Medical Policy and CMS guidance, the CMS guidance will govern.

vague_terms.quote: continues to use and benefit from the device
vague_terms.problem: No measure of use or benefit

vague_terms.quote: Company policy criteria or applicable utilization management vendor criteria may be applied

extraction_hazards: Two-column table where left cell is the service and right cell the criteria; wrapped text
Coverage Quick Guide is a 7-column matrix flattened by pdftotext
Quotes from LCD embedded in the policy
Sidebar table of contents in the header
interesting_structures: Lookup matrix device x condition -> external document
Hierarchy rule: CMS guidance governs conflicts

fit_to_tree.why: Mostly a router to CMS documents; the policy has no OSA or RAD thresholds, so the tree must come from NCD/LCD text not in this PDF.
